name: robots/huggingface__lerobot-libero
title: LIBERO coffee-table manipulation environment
intro: LIBERO coffee-table manipulation environment, adapted from huggingface/lerobot-libero. It reads `observation`, `tick`, `seed`, `reward` and 1 more; runs `reset_world` and `step`. `reset_world`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
